name: Shikishima Natsume
source:
Screen name: YamatoHime
Class: Hunter

[url=/c18358]Shuuho's[/url] childhood friend and senpai. Because she considers herself a reliable onee-san, she always looks after Shuuho and [url=/c18315]Ririko[/url] because their parents are rarely home, and is like a guardian to them. While she is a carefree girl, she is actually very proficient in all household chores. While her grades are honor student level, she also is a legend at spreading rumors on the internet. She was invited to play Wizard Generation by her online acquaintance [url=/c18311]Anonym[/url] (Anon), but because she knows that Shuuho also plays the game, she is rarely online. Natsume is also bad at cooking.
